game: SF @ LA Week 5 2025, kickoff 2025-10-02 20:15 ET, LA -8.5, total 43.5, dome

script.base: LA is a home favorite in a dome with implied team total 26.0 against an SF offense at 17.5 that is without Brock Purdy, Ricky Pearsall, Jauan Jennings and Jordan Watkins. Stafford's EPA/db is +0.26 when not blitzed and SF blitzes only 25%, so LA should lead by halftime and close with Kyren Williams (50 carries, 237 rush yards in weeks 2-4). Trailing SF funnels the remaining short pass game through Christian McCaffrey (33 targets, 212 rec yards, only 107 air yards over those three games).
script.flip1: The unnamed backup keeps SF within a score, LA throws at the middle (SF allows 9.37 YPA on 19 middle attempts) instead of clocking Kyren, and SF uses McCaffrey as a runner to protect the new QB so the receiving over stalls near his 70.7 L3 average.
script.flip2: LA is up by multiple scores by half, Blake Corum (22 carries, 118 yards in weeks 2-4) closes, Kyren's late snaps get cut under 71.5, and McCaffrey is sat before vacated Pearsall/Jennings targets (22 and 14 over three games) can clear 72.5.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game nflverse report: SF QB Brock Purdy Out (toe), WR Ricky Pearsall Out (knee; 22 targets/219 yards L3), WR Jauan Jennings Out (ankle; 14/113), WR Jordan Watkins Out (calf), DE Robert Beal Jr. Out, DT CJ West Questionable (thumb). Pack does not name Purdy's replacement; M.Jones is the only other SF rusher listed (3 carries, 9 yards L3), not a confirmed starter. Vacated WR targets land on the remaining pass options: McCaffrey already leads the team (33 targets), then Jake Tonges (13/110), Kendrick Bourne (13/87) and Kyle Juszczyk (5/38). LA T Rob Havenstein Doubtful (ankle) is a run-game downgrade for Kyren/Corum, not a skill-position sleeper. LA TE Tyler Higbee Doubtful (hip; 11 targets/62 yards L3) leaves no other LA TE on the board; any bump goes to Nacua, Adams, Whittington or Kyren, and those median stand-ins are unadjusted. Source: pack injury block plus weeks 2-4 target/carry tables.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting in the pack, so MOFO/MOFC and man/zone are unknown. Proxy only: LA blitz 33%, SF blitz 25%. LA defense YPA: left 8.5 (54 att), middle 6.5 (18), right 5.19 (53). SF defense YPA: left 6.15 (54), middle 9.37 (19), right 3.75 (48).
matchup.pressure: LA blitzes 33%, which is the checkdown lever for a backup QB, but SF's +0.23 EPA/db vs blitz (vs +0.08 unblitzed) is a Purdy sample and does not transfer. LA is the offense that fits the pressure split: -0.03 EPA/db vs blitz and +0.26 when not blitzed, and SF only blitzes 25%.
matchup.bleeds: SF bleeds the middle (9.37 YPA) and is sound to the right (3.75). LA bleeds left (8.5 YPA) and has allowed 12 passes of 20+ (139 yards) in 4 games; SF has allowed only 7 (126 yards). Run defense is ordinary on both sides: LA 4.00 YPC and 10 runs of 10+, SF 4.13 YPC and 8 runs of 10+. Neither front is a stated bleed.
matchup.overlap: SF's remaining primary option is McCaffrey (33 targets, about 3.2 air yards per target) into LA's 33% blitz, a checkdown overlap, not a charted hole vs a named coverage player. LA's primary option is Puka Nacua (39 targets, 373 yards L3) against a middle that SF opens up, but the 121.5 stand-in sits on a 170-yard spike (other L3 games 91 and 112), so that overlap is not a bet.

form: Use weeks 2-4, not a season average. McCaffrey rec L3 is 212/3 = 70.7, under the 72.5 stand-in; last4 recyds 73, 52, 88, 72 is 2-2. His rush L3 is 156/3 = 52.0 on 47 carries, also at the 53.5 stand-in (last4 69, 55, 52, 49). Kyren rush L3 is 237/3 = 79.0 on 50 carries (4.74 YPC), above 71.5, but last4 is split 66, 66, 94, 77. Corum L3 39.3 rush yards is volatile (last4 2, 44, 53, 21). Tonges L3 110/3 = 36.7 clears 26.5 (component games 31, 21, 58 if the excluded last4 game is the 15). Bourne L3 29.0 is under 32.5. Adams' L3 72.7 is a 106-yard game plus two 56s, so he is not beating 56.5 on the typical night. Nacua's L3 124.3 is the 170 spike over 91 and 112. Whittington's L3 18.7 vs a 7.5 median is the same one-game (42) inflation. No similar-defense chart and no play-level explosive split beyond the team 10+/20+ counts.

pro_edge.implied_totals: LA 26.0, SF 17.5 from total 43.5 and spread 8.5, matching the precomputed scan: favorite (43.5+8.5)/2 = 26.0, dog (43.5-8.5)/2 = 17.5.
pro_edge.script_read: Mid total, dome, favorite by 8.5: more plays than a slog but not a 50-point shootout. Dog SF (spread 8.5) should throw more, which lifts McCaffrey/Tonges/Bourne targets; the leader should run late, which lifts Kyren's carries. Blowout risk is real but not a 14-point flag, so starter snaps are at risk only if the lead stretches. Build usage from shares: Kyren 50 of 72 listed RB carries L3; McCaffrey 33 of the listed SF targets and the clear next share of Pearsall+Jennings' 36 targets.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price saved on any prop, including both selected rungs. Anchor no-vig N/A. Power devig vs overround cannot be shown. Stand-ins are 2025 season-to-date medians, not shoppable books. Alt no-vig method does not apply.
pro_edge.lagging: No book board to mark a lagging number. The analog is structural: CMC 72.5, Bourne 32.5, Tonges 26.5 and Juszczyk 18.5 are unadjusted medians, so they lag the Purdy/Pearsall/Jennings/Watkins outs. Kyren 71.5 also has not been shown moving for Havenstein Doubtful.
pro_edge.sleepers: Out: Purdy, Pearsall, Jennings, Watkins, Beal. Doubtful: Havenstein, Higbee. Questionable: CJ West. Same-position SF beneficiaries with unmoved median lines: McCaffrey, Tonges, Bourne, Juszczyk. Higbee Doubtful has no other LA TE on the board; do not treat Whittington 7.5 as a sleeper over because the L3 56 yards include a 42. Havenstein is an OL downgrade for the LA run, not a skill-position sleeper. Low-confidence by rule: no live reprice, no limits, no +300 alt to fade.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the backup could not move the ball, LA led by three scores at half, Corum closed, and McCaffrey was done after a handful of short catches that Tonges and Bourne also shared, finishing under 72.5, while Havenstein's absence plus a 4.13 YPC SF front held Kyren in the mid-60s the way two of his last four games already did. That counter is real enough to flag Kyren as a lean and to refuse a third SF pass-catcher, but it is not stronger than the McCaffrey vacancy read, so that leg stays flagged rather than cut.
slip_story: One story only: LA leads and clocks through Kyren, SF trails without Purdy and its top WRs and dumps short to McCaffrey. Do not add a total under, a Nacua/Adams over, or a Corum over; those need a shootout or a blowout this stack does not. Tonges over 26.5 is the same SF checkdown story and was left off to keep the slip to two legs. No TDs, one market per player, no bet placed.
